QuestInfo.name: Philius's Call
QuestInfo.0: You hear a voice calling to you. A gentle, sing-songy voice... Could it be... #p1033100#?
QuestInfo.1: #b#p1033100##k, who was trapped by the Black Mage's Curse, is awake. Return to #b#m101050000##k and check on #p1033100#.
QuestInfo.2: #p1033100# said that the Curse of the Black Mage hadn't been lifted yet, and thought that you were able to wake up because of your royal blood. Since you and #p1033100# were connected, he was able to wake up when you became more powerful.

0.3: Where are you, Your Highness? Why are you not in your quarters? \r\n#L0##b#p1033100#? You're awake?#l\n#k
0.4: So it would seem, Your Majesty. Everyone else is still trapped in the ice, but...where are you? I feared for the worst when you weren't in your room.\r\n#L0##bIt's a long story. I'll tell you everything, but I need to see you in person. Let's meet back in the village.#l\n#k
0.5: As you wish, Your Majesty. I will be waiting.\r\n#b#e(You will be moved to Elluel if you accept.)#n#k

1.0: Your Highness! I'm so happy to see you safe. I was worried...\r\n#L0##bYou look tired. Are you all right?#l\n#k
1.1: Don't worry about me. It's just the aftermath of the curse. I'm more worried about the village. Why isn't anyone else waking up?\r\n#L0##bIt's been this way, #p1033100#. I've been awake for a while now, and you're the only other Elf who's woken up since. When I heard your voice, I'd hoped the Black Mage's curse had been lifted...#l\n#k
1.2: I don't understand it either, My Liege. The Black Mage uses powerful, forbidden magic, much of which even I don't understand. But you were going to tell me your story, yes? I'm eager to find out what's happened.\r\n#L0##b(You tell him everything that's happened: awakening from your slumber weak and alone, in a world centuries removed from the Victoria Island you once knew. And you tell him of your quest to regain your strength and free the Elves of the Black Mage's curse.)#l\n#k
1.3: Your Majesty... I'm sorry. I've failed you. This should never have happened...\r\n#L0##bIt's all right, #p1033100#. I've only done what I can to help my people. Right now, I need to know what you think of this situation.#l\n#k
1.4: It's clear that the Black Mage's curse is still in effect. Somehow, #ba crack has formed in the curse#k, but it's still there. That's why you woke up, Your Highness.\r\n#L0##bThen why are you awake, too?#l\n#k
1.5: I believe it's because of you, Your Majesty. Because you are awake, the crack in the curse is growing. And it will continue to grow as you become stronger.\r\n#L0##bThen I must continue to build my strength.#l\n#k
1.6: Exactly. I am the most powerful of the three elders, so I woke up first. If you continue to grow, the other two elders will wake up soon...\r\n#L0##bI see. And what of the rest of my people?#l\n#k
1.7: #bYour strength is the strength of all Elves#k. Once you regain your full strength, even the weakest among us should awaken.\r\n#L0##bVery well. My path is clear. I must return to the world beyond Elluel and continue to train. #p1033100#, will you come with me?#l\n#k
1.8: If Your Majesty will allow it, I think I should stay here. I'm still too weak to survive outside of the village. Besides, someone must stay behind and watch over the other Elves while you train.

yes.0: I'm proud of you, My Liege. You woke up here, alone, and still managed to rise above it and weaken the curse even more. It is an honor to serve such a great hero.
yes.1: The other elders will awaken soon. Come, let's watch.
